english.legislation: Contrary to section 167(1) and (5) of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The displaying of a sign on a vehicle is not soliciting.
(ii) Soliciting need not refer to any particular vehicle - subsection 167(2).
(iii) See subsection 167(3) for exceptions and subsection 167(6) for definitions.
(iv) Made a recordable offence as from 1/12/03 by the National Police Records (Recordable Offences)(Amendment) Regulations 2003. Therefore offenders must be fingerprinted and photographed as well as PNC recordable.
